'''Brult Kiais''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Kiais worked as a [[Bank/Legends|banker]] and invested heavily with [[Zerex]], the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]]. When Zerex was promoted to become the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], Kiais attended a celebratory party that Zerex held in his mansion on Ord Adinorr.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
